pages.text: $(italic)Sustained melee damage dealer. Gets stronger as HP drops. The 'I don't need to dodge, I need to hit harder' class.$()$(br2)HP Modifier: -5%  |  Equipment HP: Full$(br)$(bold)Weapon Affinities:$() Axes deal +15% damage. Bows and magic deal less.

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Blood Fury$() — Below 40% HP: +20% melee damage. The core identity passive. Gets stronger the closer to death you are.$(br2)$(bold)Thick Skinned$() — +10% armor effectiveness from worn armor pieces. Compensates for the -5% HP penalty and rewards investing in heavy armor.$(br2)$(bold)Battle Trance$() — After sustained combat (10+ seconds): +5% all damage dealt, -5% all damage taken. Rewards staying in fights rather than kiting.

pages.title: Weapon Affinity
pages.text: Axes are the Berserker's primary weapon. The +15% axe damage bonus means axes outperform swords significantly for this class. Bows and magic are penalized — the $(thing)Berserker$() is meant to be in melee range.$(br2)$(bold)Best race pairings:$()$(br)$(thing)Orc$() — +12% attack speed stacks with Blood Fury for devastating sustained DPS.$(br)$(thing)Human$() — Versatile bonus keeps up with any content.$(br)$(thing)Dwarf$() — Fire resistance lets you fight in lava zones without retreating.
